items.badge_description: Hoppy IPA Day! Did you know that, since our inception in 2010, our hoppy lil’ community has checked in over 400 million IPAs? That’s a seriously staggering amount of hops!⁠ Today, we celebrate the hoppiest of days with the hoppiest of badges—the 2026 IPA Day Badge.

Canning is all the rage and it's not hard to see why - travels well, more environmentally friendly, and no need to carry your bottle opener. That's 430 checkins with the serving style of Can. Try 5 more for Level 87! Want to learn more about this badge? Check out our podcast

You may not be able to see through the haze, but that juicy, hoppy goodness goes down smooth. What started as a trend is here to stay.
